content: ADO rate limits (learn.microsoft.com rate-limits, updated 2026-07): global 200 TSTU per sliding 5-min window per identity; delayed requests still return HTTP 200 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Delay (delays ms to 30s); blocked requests return 429 with TF400733. Headers: Retry-After (seconds), X-RateLimit-Resource, -Delay, -Limit, -Remaining, -Reset (epoch), -Cost. Headers sent before delays start so clients can slow proactively. Work item queries cost scales with org size.
